business_summary: Jiangsu Apon Medical Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of medical devices for anesthesia and analgesia, nasal airway, and chronic pain management in China. It offers pain management services, such as high-precision intelligent microcomputer infusion pumps, wireless analgesia management systems, internal heat needle therapy devices, low-frequency therapy devices, and shockwave therapy devices; and iPainfree, a wireless analgesia management system software. The company also provides nasal and upper airway management solutions, including daily nasal care, perioperative care for nasal diseases, rhinitis diagnosis and treatment, snoring diagnosis and treatment, and allergy treatment; and sleep monitoring and improvement solutions. In addition, it is involved in research and development of digital diagnostic and treatment products for neurological diseases, cognitive training, and sleep monitoring; and research, development, production, and sale of medical devices comprising brain neuromodulation and intracranial implantable electrodes. Jiangsu Apon Medical Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Nantong, China.
